maria_cs: MicroCert pilot (Cadet cohort) — need to schedule three evening enablement sessions next week for customers migrating to Dedicated (APAC + EMEA). Dates proposed: Nov 14, 16, 18. Prefer 21:00 UTC to catch APAC late hours. Also flagging KestrelMed as a renewal-risk account; we should offer a 1:1 before week-end. Who can cover trainers + a short agenda?

jon_eng: I can take 11/14 and 11/16 at 21:00 UTC. Happy to demo migration steps and common errors. Do we have a runbook link?

tess_enable: I can cover 11/18. Will prepare a demo-heavy checklist + a short troubleshooting lab.

raj_sre: I'll be on standby for infra questions, can join the first 30 mins of each session (not full slots).

oliver_pm: Suggest 20m demo, 25m hands-on lab, 15m Q&A, 10m feedback/survey. Also add a targeted agenda for KestrelMed 1:1. I can draft the survey.

maria_cs: Cool — creating a quick poll for the cohort time preference for APAC folks (21:00 UTC vs 00:00 UTC). Please react only so we keep thread tidy. :calendar:

reminder-bot: Poll created: https://redwood.tools/polls/7154321000 — options: 21:00 UTC, 00:00 UTC. Poll closes in 24h.

jon_eng: Voted 21:00. Also added two sample calendar slots to the Cohort Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/c/microcert-cadet

maria_cs: Linking runbook + proposed concise agenda below — please review and flag anything missing.

```
Proposed agenda (60m)
- 00:00–00:05 Intro & objective (maria_cs)
- 00:05–00:25 Migration demo: model pinning, KV cache warmup, quantization tradeoffs (jon_eng)
- 00:25–00:50 Hands-on lab: small migration tasks in dev environment (tess_enable)
- 00:50–00:60 Q&A + next steps + feedback form (oliver_pm)
Post-session: share cohort notes + quick CSAT form; flag accounts with any activation blockers for renewal follow-up.
```

ajira: Created ticket CS-1289 to track KestrelMed 1:1 + renewal playbook (assigned to maria_cs).

tess_enable: I'll prepare 2 short prompt sets and one fail-case to exercise the Dedicated runtime.

raj_sre: If anyone expects heavy KV usage in the lab, let me know so I can pre-warm nodes.

maria_cs: Thanks all — locking trainers: jon_eng (14,16), tess_enable (18), raj_sre standby, oliver_pm runs feedback. I'll send invites once poll closes. Please add any follow-ups in CS-1289. :thumbsup:
